verses.1: When God created the heavens, he created the earth, and God created the heavens, and God created the heavens.
verses.2: Now the earth was unoccupied and darkness covered the face of the deep, and the heaven of God hovered over the face of the sea.
verses.3: Then God said, "Let there be light, " and there was light.
verses.4: God saw that the light was good, and he divided the light from the darkness.
verses.5: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And there was evening, and there was morning - a first day.
verses.6: Then God said, "Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters".
verses.7: And God opened the expanse and separated the waters that were under the expanse from the waters that were under the expanse, and so it was.
verses.8: And God called the expanse Heaven. And there was evening and there was morning, the second day.
verses.9: Then God said, "Let the waters under the sky be gathered together into one place, and let the dry land appear. " And so it was.
verses.10: And God called the dry land Earth, and the gathering together of waters he called Rivers. And God saw that it was good.
verses.11: Then God said, "Let the earth bring forth grass - plants with their seeds in them, trees yielding fruit - according to their kinds on the earth. " And it was so.
verses.12: The earth brought forth grass, herbs yielding seed, and trees yielding fruit in which is their seed. And God saw that it was good.
verses.13: And it was evening, and it was morning - the third day.
verses.14: Then God said, "Let there be lights in the firmament to divide the day from the night; let them be for signs, and for seasons and days and years".
verses.15: to give light in the sky so that they may give light on the earth. " And so it was.
verses.16: And God made the two great lights, the greater light to rule the day and the lesser light to rule the night, and the stars.
verses.17: And God set them in the firmament of the heavens to give light on the earth,
verses.18: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to separate the light from the darkness. And God saw that this was good.
verses.19: And there was evening and there was morning - the fourth day.
verses.20: And God said, "Let the waters abound in living creatures, and let swarms of moving creatures swarm about the earth in the expanse of the heavens".
verses.21: Then God made the great sea monsters and every living creature that moves, which the waters give life to, each according to its own kind. And God knew that this was good.
verses.22: God blessed them and said to them, "Be fruitful and multiply; fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth".
verses.23: And the evening came and the morning came, the fifth day.
verses.24: And God said, "Let the earth bring forth living creatures according to their kinds - beasts, livestock, reptiles, and animals of the earth " - and it was so.
verses.25: So God created the beasts of the earth in their own kind, and the cattle in their own kind, and the birds in their own kind, and the birds of the air in their own kind, and the birds of the air in their own kind.
verses.26: Then God said, "Let us make man in our image, according to our likeness; and let them rule over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the air, over the cattle, over the whole earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth".
verses.27: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God he created him. Male and female he created them.
verses.28: And God blessed them. He said to them, "Be fruitful and multiply; fill the earth, and fill it with the children of God".
verses.29: Then God said, "I have given you every fruit - bearing tree that is on the face of the whole earth and every tree that has fruit in it to be your food.
verses.30: To every beast of the earth and to every tree on the earth that has life in it, I give every green plant for food. " And so it was.
verses.31: And God saw everything he had made and, look! it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.
